title: The people who only need four hours' sleep
summary: Some people can sleep for only four hours and still feel very energetic. Scientists discovered that rare gene mutations cause this special ability. These genes might also protect people from the bad health effects of little sleep.

title: CONTROL AND CHOICE
summary: Stoic philosophy teaches us to know the difference between what we cannot change and what we can. We often waste time on things outside our control, like bad weather or other people's opinions. Instead, we should focus our energy on our own choices today. This brings us happiness and success.
